   626→<script>
   627→/* ============ mini quilt — the reactive engine powering this page ============
   628→   Same semantics as the full runtime, small enough to read in one coffee:
   629→   value cells, formulas with declared dependencies, listeners that fire on
   630→   change (including formulas that recompute mid-cascade), and an event bus
   631→   every console in this page listens to. */
   632→const Bus = {
   633→  fns: new Set(),
   634→  pulses: 0,
   635→  emit(ev) { this.pulses++; for (const f of this.fns) f(ev); },
   636→  on(f) { this.fns.add(f); return () => this.fns.delete(f); }
   637→};
   638→function sameV(a, b) {
   639→  if (a === b) return true;
   640→  if (typeof a !== typeof b || a === null || b === null) return false;
   641→  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) return a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => sameV(x, b[i]));
   642→  if (typeof a === 'object' && typeof b === 'object') {
   643→    const ka = Object.keys(a), kb = Object.keys(b);
   644→    return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every(k => sameV(a[k], b[k]));
   645→  }
   646→  return false;
   647→}
   648→class Sheet {
   649→  constructor(name) {
   650→    this.name = name; this.cells = new Map(); this.watchers = [];
   651→    this.depth = 0; this.dead = false; this._changed = new Map();
   652→  }
   653→  cell(id, value, opts = {}) {
   654→    let c = this.cells.get(id);
   655→    if (!c) { c = { id, kind: 'value', deps: [], fn: null, value }; this.cells.set(id, c); }
   656→    else if (c.kind === 'formula') throw new Error(`cell ${id} is a formula`);
   657→    this._set(c, value, !!opts.silent);
   658→    return c;
   659→  }
   660→  def(id, deps, fn) {
   661→    const c = { id, kind: 'formula', deps: deps.slice(), fn, value: undefined, stale: true };
   662→    this.cells.set(id, c);
   663→    this._eval(c);
   664→    return c;
   665→  }
   666→  watch(target, fn) { this.watchers.push({ target, fn }); }
   667→  get(id) {
   668→    const c = this.cells.get(id);
   669→    if (!c) return undefined;
   670→    if (c.kind === 'formula' && c.stale) this._eval(c);
   671→    return c.value;
   672→  }
   673→  _eval(c) {
   674→    c.stale = false;
   675→    let nv;
   676→    try { nv = c.fn(...c.deps.map(d => this.get(d))); }
   677→    catch (e) { nv = { __error: String(e && e.message || e) }; }
   678→    this._set(c, nv, false);
   679→  }
   680→  _set(c, v, silent) {
   681→    if (sameV(c.value, v)) return;
   682→    const old = c.value; c.value = v;
   683→    if (!silent) Bus.emit({ sheet: this.name, id: c.id, kind: c.kind, old, v });
   684→    if (this.dead) return;
   685→    if (this.depth > 60) {
   686→      this.dead = true;
   687→      Bus.emit({ sheet: this.name, id: 'engine', kind: 'error', old: null, v: 'cascade too deep — cycle guard tripped' });
   688→      return;
   689→    }
   690→    if (!this._changed.has(c.id)) this._changed.set(c.id, [old, v]);
   691→    else this._changed.get(c.id)[1] = v;
   692→    this.depth++;
   693→    for (const [, dc] of this.cells)
   694→      if (dc.kind === 'formula' && !dc.stale && dc.deps.includes(c.id)) { dc.stale = true; this._eval(dc); }
   695→    this.depth--;
   696→    if (this.depth === 0 && !this.dead && this._changed.size) {
   697→      const changed = [...this._changed.entries()];
   698→      this._changed.clear();
   699→      for (const [id, [o, v]] of changed)
   700→        for (const w of this.watchers)
   701→          if (w.target === id) {
   702→            try { w.fn(o, v); }
   703→            catch (e) { Bus.emit({ sheet: this.name, id: id + ':watch', kind: 'error', old: null, v: String(e && e.message || e) }); }
   704→          }
   705→    }
   706→  }
   707→}
